notes.subject: פקדוך
notes.rationale: 'Visited/sought you' (KJV) vs 'missed you' (ylt reads פקד as fail); this rendering takes the 'sought' reading.

notes.subject: prea long voes liklik
notes.rationale: לחש is literally a whisper or murmur; 'quiet prayer' keeps the hushed sound.

notes.subject: למו
notes.rationale: Poetic particle with no standalone meaning; elided.

translation: Yahwe, long taim bilong trabl, ol i painim yu; taim yu skelim ol, ol i was save tokim yu prea long voes liklik ⟨long taim bilong pen⟩.
